notes: Both prior rejection points are fixed: server/internal/httpapi/mcpoauth_test.go:154 pins the /mcp refusal line (request_id == body requestId, path=/mcp, error="sso token refused: audience") through the real Handler(); server/internal/mcpoauth/authenticator_test.go:130 gives the fixture a bytes.Buffer logger and asserts the switched-on warning is present with Enabled=true and absent with Enabled=false.

Mutation probes all fail the suite: dropping request_id from the /mcp OnError, dropping the switched-on Warn, making forThisServer always true, ignoring account.Disabled, removing the azp check in oidc.go validateClaims, removing the mcp_oauth branch in allowScope, and writing refusal.Error() instead of Message to the client.

Protected-file checklist: default off (mcp.oauth.enabled=false in defaultSettings, additive only); the only new unauthenticated path is the RFC 9728 metadata document, 404 while SSO is inactive; aud allowed values come only from mcp.oauth.resource / PUBLIC_BASE_URL and the admin's audience list, never Host; GetUserBySubject only looks up (no upsert, no role from token, disabled account refused); Refusal.Message reaches the client, Cause only the log; the JWKS fetch runs under a separate refreshMu so cache hits do not queue behind it; no migration deletes or renames.

Behavior change to be aware of: with OIDC enabled, a web sign-in token presented directly at /mcp used to be accepted with unbounded scope via the OIDC authenticator; now it is refused unless SSO is on and the client is listed (session cookies and API keys unchanged). This is the intended tightening and is covered by TestTheAudienceRuleIsTheResourceOrTheAdministratorsList.

Minor non-blocking drift: web/src/pages/mcpsso.ts grantableScopes omits api_keys:manage and mcp:use which the server's keys.ValidateScopes would accept; grantedScopes hands the admin's whole list when the token's scopes do not overlap it (never exceeds the ceiling; HasScope treats empty as none, so no unlimited interpretation).
go build/vet and go test -race pass for auth, mcpoauth, httpapi; runner verify.json shows all 9 gates green.
